description: The Luhn algorithm is a simple checksum formula used to validate various identification numbers, primarily to detect accidental errors like single-digit mistakes or transposed digits during manual data entry. It can be used to determine if a string (numbers) can be potentially represent credit card numbers, IMEI numbers, and other numerical identifiers.

inputs.description: The string (number) to evaluate with the Luhn algorithm
inputs.name: input_string
inputs.placeholder: The string to evaluate with the Luhn algorithm

outputs.description: The verdict of applying the Luhn algorithm against input_string
